hooks.prompt: The assistant may stop unless all of these hold: it is executing a plan the user approved, authorized work in that plan remains, and its latest message neither asks the user for a decision, reports a blocker, nor reports completion with evidence. Ordinary conversation, planning, and questions may always stop. When it may not stop, the reason names the next authorized step.

hooks.command: echo "If this session owns an approved jwn run, re-read its .jwn/<task>/STATUS.md and PLAN.md, then continue only within the recorded authorization."
